title: The Holy Spirit
description: The Holy Spirit is God himself, sent to live inside every believer — to comfort, teach, empower, and change us from the inside out.

waypoints.title: God Living Inside
waypoints.body: Before Jesus returned to heaven, he promised his followers wouldn't be left alone -- he would send the Holy Spirit to be with them forever, teaching, comforting, and giving them power to live for him.

waypoints.title: Growing Fruit
waypoints.body: Which 'fruit of the Spirit' (love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control) do you most want God to grow in you this year?
